transcript: Speaker A: I got this designer saree for 20,000. Can you believe it? Speaker B: Oh my God, it looks so good on you. Speaker A: What about you, Gobi? Where did you get that suit? Speaker C: Mmm... Mujhe English itni samajh nahi aati. [Mmm... I don't understand English that much.] Speaker D: Kya hua Gobi? Tum ro kyun rahi ho? [What happened Gobi? Why are you crying?] Speaker C: Aaj kitty party me sab mujhpe hase kyunki mujhe English bolni nahi aati. [Today at the kitty party everyone laughed at me because I don't know how to speak English.] Speaker D: Bas itni si baat? Tum PW Talk app use karna shuru karo. Dekho, isme ek AI English teacher hai, Riva. Tum isse roz 10 minute baat karo. Yeh tumhe English bolna sikha degi. Galti bhi ho to sharmao mat, Riva judge nahi karegi. Yeh tumhe daily life me English me kaise baat karna hai, yeh sikha degi. Isme dher saare practice questions aur videos hai tumhare liye, jisse tum English bolna seekh sakti ho. Daily practice karo, level up karo, aur dekho kaise mahine bhar me tum confidently English bolne lagti ho. Phir dekhte hai kiski himmat hai jo tumhara mazaak udaye. [Just that? You start using the PW Talk app. Look, it has an AI English teacher, Riva. Talk to her for 10 minutes daily. She will teach you how to speak English. Even if you make a mistake, don't be shy, Riva won't judge you. She will teach you how to speak English in daily life. It has lots of practice questions and videos for you, through which you can learn to speak English. Practice daily, level up, and see how within a month you start speaking English confidently. Then let's see who dares to make fun of you.]

Her friend, a cabbage, consoles her and recommends the PW Talk app, highlighting its non-judgmental AI teacher Riva, daily practice features, and videos.
